scope: Actual Pi ExtensionRunner lazy context getters, tool event callbacks and resources_discover startup/reload versus native tool execution context, lifecycle handlers, UI adapter and extension resource discovery. Random session identifiers are excluded; cwd/model/provider and semantic callback order are compared.

processEvidence.rpc: RpcExtensionContextProcessTests: a real CLI RPC process invokes the fixture tool against a loopback provider and asserts working directory, rpc mode, headless UI state, trust, current model/provider/session, active tool set, progress update, notification, and lifecycle callback order.
processEvidence.pty: TerminalPtyTests.InteractiveReloadRunsNativeExtensionResourceDiscoveryAgain: a Linux PTY starts the interactive CLI, runs /reload, and observes startup plus reload resource callbacks.

scopeLimitations: The native context exposes the current project, model, provider, session metadata, active tools, idle state, and shared CLI UI adapter. It does not expose unsupported TypeScript-only mutable internals such as Pi SessionManager or model-registry objects.
The event differential normalizes Pi tool_call/tool_result hooks and tool updates to the corresponding native tool lifecycle boundaries.
